record.question: Which country tested hydrogen bomb in September, 2017?
record.explanation: Answer B: North Korea. CTBTO records the 3 September 2017 explosion at the DPRK test site. North Korea is the uniquely relevant country. Historical/source note: Hydrogen-bomb characterization was the DPRK’s announcement; the cited monitoring record establishes location/event, not independently verified fusion design. Reference: https://www.ctbto.org/our-work/detecting-nuclear-tests/2017-dprk-nuclear-test. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
